title: New York City Sunset Helicopter Tour from New Jersey
includes: Shuttle transportation to & from Linden train station (Request Only)
Live pilot narration, floor-to-ceiling windows, climate controlled cabin
Heliport Landing & Facility Fees (No unexpected fees upon arrival)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Please note: it is a 10 minute drive to the Linden Airport from the train station, so passengers can request a free shuttle from HeliNY in advance from the Linden, NJ train station, or order either Uber, Lyft or use the local taxi service.
A current valid government issued photo ID is required on the day of travel.
All passengers are required to sign a waiver prior to flying.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience New York City at its most breathtaking moments - from the sky at sunset. As the sun dips below the horizon, the city glows in a golden light, reflecting off the Hudson River and simmering glass towers of Manhattan. 

Your helicopter lifts off for an unforgettable journey over the city’s most famous landmarks - from the Statue of Liberty and the One World Trade Center to the Empire State Building, Central Park, and the Chrysler Building. You’ll take in both the West Side skyline along the Hudson and the East Side views overlooking the United Nations, the East River bridges, and the iconic cityscape of Midtown and Lower Manhattan.

As day turns to night, the lights of New York begin to sparkle beneath you, transforming the skyline into a sea of color and brilliance. It’s a breathtaking perspective — romantic, peaceful, and utterly mesmerizing.
